response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM rental re JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = re.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), o AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS overall_avg FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.cnt) AS avg_above_rentals, AVG(r.cnt - o.overall_avg) AS avg_excess FROM r CROSS JOIN o WHERE r.cnt > o.overall_avg
